'''Kare Narain Pathak''' {{Post-nominals|list=[[Indian National Science Academy|FNA]], [[Indian Academy of Sciences|FASc]], [[National Academy of Sciences, India|FNASc]]}} is an Indian Theoretical Condensed Matter [[Physicist]], Professor [[Emeritus]] and Former [[Vice-chancellor|Vice-Chancellor]] of the [[Panjab University]]. He is an elected Fellow of several science academies such as the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]], [[Indian National Science Academy]], [[National Academy of Sciences, India]], [[National Research Council Canada]] and Punjab Academy of Sciences.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Former PU-VC professor selected as INSA fellow - Indian Express|url=http://archive.indianexpress.com/news/former-puvc-professor-selected-as-insa-fellow/372076/|access-date=2022-02-08|website=archive.indianexpress.com}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Kare Narain Pathak was born at Baragaon-Chaukhari Village in [[Bhadohi district|Bhadohi District]], [[Uttar Pradesh]] on 30 July 1941. He earned the B.Sc. and M.Sc. degrees from [[Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University|K N Govt College, Gyanpur (Agra University)]] and the [[University of Allahabad]], respectively. After that, he joined the [[Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur]], to work on theoretical solid state physics and obtained a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] degree in 1967.<ref>{{Cite web|title=INSA :: Indian Fellow Detail|url=https://www.insaindia.res.in/detail.php?id=P09-1490|access-date=2022-02-03|website=www.insaindia.res.in}}</ref>

After a brief stint as lecturer in physics at [[IIT Bombay|IIT Mumbai]], for about a year, Pathak worked as Postdoctoral Research Fellow during 1967–70 at [[National Research Council Canada|National Research Council, Canada]] and [[Northwestern University]], U.S.A.

In 1970, he was invited by [[Panjab University]], Chandigarh, to join as a Reader in the Department of Physics. He became Professor of Physics in 1977 and remained Professor until 2001.He worked in various capacities as Head of the department of physics, Dean of faculty of science, Dean of university instruction, and thereafter vice-chancellor (2000–06).<ref>{{Cite web|title=PIB Press Releases|url=https://archive.pib.gov.in/archive/releases98/lyr2003/rjul2003/02072003/r020720038.html|access-date=2022-02-08|website=archive.pib.gov.in}}</ref> After his superannuation, he worked as a senior scientist of the [[Indian National Science Academy]] and [[National Academy of Sciences, India]] for 10 Years.<ref>{{Cite web| title=Curriculum vitae - Dr. K. N. Pathak | url=https://physics.puchd.ac.in/faculty/cv/pathak.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160427063631/http://physics.puchd.ac.in/faculty/cv/pathak.pdf | archive-date=2016-04-27}}</ref>

He is a chairman of [[Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research|Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research, Chandigarh]], the ethics committee of biomedical research, drug trials, member of organ transplant committee, and the ethics committee for stem cell research.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://pgimer.edu.in/PGIMER_PORTAL/PGIMERPORTAL/GlobalPages/JSP/Page_Data.jsp?dep_id=449 | title=PGIMER, Chandigarh }}</ref>

He has received D.Sc. (Honoris Causa) from [[Desh Bhagat University|Desh Bhagat University, Mandi Gobindgarh, Punjab]] on 14th Feb 2021 for his exceptional contribution in the condensed matter [[Physicist|physics]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Celebration of 9th Convocation & Alumni Meet at Desh Bhagat University|url=https://www.deshsewak.org/english/news/-56262|access-date=2022-02-17|website=www.deshsewak.org}}</ref>

== Academic and research ==
K.N. Pathak has made distinct contributions in our understanding of structure and dynamics of classical & quantum liquids, including electron correlation effects in Coulomb systems.  He is known for his contribution nationally and internationally particularly for obtaining several exact results for the dynamical correlation function for the above systems. His theory of phonon-phonon interaction in solids provides for the first time both thermodynamic and dynamic properties in a self-consistent manner. It has been successfully applied to explain various phenomena connected with phonon-phonon interaction.<ref>{{Cite web|title=INSA :: Indian Fellow Detail|url=https://www.insaindia.res.in/detail.php?id=P09-1490|access-date=2022-02-07|website=www.insaindia.res.in}}</ref>

* Research Papers published in international journals - 140 and Review Articles - 7.<ref>{{Cite web|title=K N pathak|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=GP3S5oEAAAAJ&hl=en|access-date=2022-02-07|website=scholar.google.com}}</ref>
* Supervised 13 PhD. Thesis and 6 M.Phil. Thesis. Supervised 5 postdoctoral fellows (Dr D K Chaturvedi, Dr Keya, Dharam Vir, Dr Vinod Ashokan, Dr Rajesh Sharma)

== Legacy ==
During his tenure as a Vice-Chancellor of [[Panjab University]] (2000–06), he has established crucial institutions such as the [[University Institute of Engineering and Technology, Panjab University|University Institute of Engineering and Technology (UIET)]], University Institute of Legal Studies, [[Dr Harvansh Singh Judge Institute of Dental Sciences and Hospital]], Center for Defense and National security studies, Panjab University Regional centres at Hoshiarpur & Ludhiana, UGC Center for Human Genome Studies.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2012-10-10|title=Former PU V-Cs share their memories, advice|url=https://indianexpress.com/article/cities/chandigarh/former-pu-vcs-share-their-memories-advice/|access-date=2022-02-08|website=The Indian Express|language=en}}</ref>
